original.statement: Promtail's default configuration in rpm/deb packages was improved to reduce CPU utilization when many files exist in /var/log.

exposure.needed: whether Promtail is installed from the rpm/deb packages on the host and runs the default configuration file shipped with them

corrected.statement: Promtail's default configuration shipped with the rpm/deb packages was improved to avoid possible high CPU use when /var/log holds many files. Only hosts that installed Promtail from rpm/deb and run the shipped default config are exposed, and no static input shows that.

decision.reason: [ev-d546fd91b679] limits the change to the default configuration shipped with Promtail's rpm/deb packages. The proposed condition is the wrong shape. It requires the grafana/promtail container image, which is not an rpm/deb install, so it flags container environments that are not exposed and misses package installs. It also relies on a "--config" flag that the evidence never mentions. Whether a host installed Promtail from rpm/deb and still runs the shipped default config is not visible in any static input, so the exposure has to be undecidable.
